comment: Advisories consciously accepted, checked by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Anything not listed here fails CI. Acceptances are time-boxed: past reviewBy, the gate fails until the entry is re-checked and either removed (a fix shipped) or renewed.

accepted.whyNoFix: Every minimatch release below 11.0.1 is affected, so the fix is a new major. minimatch 11.0.1 was published 2026-10-27, inside the 14-day hold for a major version. The 10.2.3 here is pinned by this repo's own override for an earlier advisory; move that override to 11.x on review.
accepted.whyNotExploitable: The DoS needs an attacker-supplied glob pattern. minimatch is reached only through glob and readdir-glob under archiver, which exceljs uses to zip the .xlsx it writes. That path appends generated entries and never globs; the server code (src/) does not import glob, minimatch or archiver, and no request data becomes a pattern.

accepted.whyNoFix: Every glob from 9.0.0 to 14.0.1 is affected, so the fix is the glob 14 major, published 2026-10-27 and inside the 14-day hold for a major version. The 11.1.0 here is pinned by this repo's own override; move it to 14.x on review.
accepted.whyNotExploitable: The bypass needs code that cancels a glob walk with an AbortSignal over an attacker-influenced tree. glob is reached only through archiver-utils and rimraf under exceljs's zip writer, which never globs request data; src/ does not import glob.
